name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Video shows drone attacking a street vendor in Ukraine
changes.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says the footage shows how Russian soldiers "take pleasure in killing" civilians.

changes.title: At least 17 people killed after fatal overnight Russian strikes in Ukraine
changes.summary: Russian missile and drone strikes on Kyiv and the surrounding region killed at least 17 people and wounded 44 others, Ukraine's state emergency service said.

changes.title: Russian missile and drone barrage in Ukrainian capital region kills 17
changes.summary: Russian missile and drone strikes on Kyiv and the surrounding region killed 17 people and wounded 44 others overnight into Wednesday, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said. (Image credit: Dan Bashakov).

changes.title: How the Ukraine War Became a Fight for the Skies
changes.summary: Russia and Ukraine are producing ever larger numbers of innovative aerial weapons, hoping for a breakthrough as ground combat is largely frozen.

changes.title: Russia’s Deadly Missile Attack on Kyiv Exploits Ukraine’s Depleted Air Defenses
changes.summary: At least 17 people were killed, officials said, as the country runs desperately low on interceptor missiles that could fend off Russian bombardments.

changes.title: Russian attack on Kyiv region kills at least 14 people, say Ukrainian authorities
changes.summary: Air raid alerts last for more than an hour as Moscow inflicts another heavy bombardment on Ukraine’s capital Russian strikes in and around Kyiv killed at least 14 people, ⁠injured 27 and ⁠damaged warehouses, ​emergency service officials said. Some reports put the death toll at 15. Air raid alerts lasted for more than a.

changes.title: Ukraine hits Russia with deadly strike near busy beach, officials say
changes.summary: A Ukrainian drone struck a busy beach off the Black Sea in a deadly attack, Russian officials said, as the two countries continue to trade strikes. CBS News' Aidan Stretch has the latest.

changes.title: Ukrainian drone strike on Russian warehouses in Moscow region kills 5, local official says
changes.summary: Ukraine has conducted long-range strikes targeting civilian infrastructure in Russia, and in recent weeks stepped up attacks on warehouses belonging to the Russian e-commerce giant Wildberries.

changes.title: Video shows moment drone burst into fireball on Russian beach
changes.summary: Russia and Ukraine traded blame after a drone slammed into a beach in the Black Sea resort town of Gelendzhik. Russian officials said seven people were killed.

changes.title: Ukraine's air defenses are proving to be a weak point
changes.summary: Ukraine's defenses have held the line on most fronts, but there's one glaring weakness -- Russian ballistic missiles. Ukraine is desperately short of U.S.-made Patriot air defense missiles needed to defend against the Russians.
